selection_rule: Maximum frozen T4 discrimination at delta_alpha_min = 7.5 deg. Layouts within the tie tolerance of the maximum are numerically tied; among tied layouts in the same solution cluster a normally converged optimizer termination is preferred over an abnormal one, then the fewest objective evaluations. Selection used only surrogate optimization diagnostics -- no physical or CFD result influenced it.
